title: the statement file
description: User story under REQ-187. The harness writes a statement file beside each source with a leading bracketed kind and a trailing (source: ...) marker; `brief add --from` parses the markers and mints the statements.
iWant: a line grammar for kind and source
soThat: the split I propose to the owner is what gets minted

acceptanceCriteria.description: [happy] given a line "- [constraint] A loan on hold must not accrue late fees. (source: briefs/x.md:15)", when brief add --from runs, then one statement is minted with kind constraint, that text and that source.
[happy] given a line with no markers under --kind actor --source doc.md, when brief add --from runs, then the statement has kind actor and source doc.md.
[happy] given a line ending with "?" and no kind marker, when brief add --from runs, then the statement has kind openQuestion.
[happy] given a 0.29.0 line-per-statement file, when brief add --from runs, then the minted statements equal the 0.29.0 output.
[failure] given a line "[gadget] text", when brief add --from runs, then it exits 2 naming the accepted kinds and writes nothing.
[must-not] given --dry-run, when brief add --from runs, then rcf/define/brief-ledger.json is not created or modified.
